newsitem.title: USA: AmEx, Italian post office in marketing deal.
newsitem.headline: AmEx, Italian post office in marketing deal.

text.p: American Express Co said Tuesday it reached a marketing agreement in which the Italian Post Office will distribute American Express Cards through its network of 15,000 branches.

American Express said the agreement will allow American Express Card holders to to settle their monthly bills through their postal accounts. Also, the card holders will be able to use the card for the post office's international express courier services.
Toby Usnik, a spokesman for American Express, said applications for the cards will be available in the post office branches, and there will be compensation to the Italian Post Office for card sales.

He said initially the effort will involve the green charge cards. "Clearly there is room for developing the relationship over time," he said. "We will work with our partner, the post office, to find the optimal fit of our products for their customers.
American Express said the agremeent was the latest in a series of deals it has entered into with financial institutions around the world.
